description: Ordered quality pipeline. Cheap and broad checks run first so that an expensive stage is only reached once the earlier ones have passed.

stages.title: Build
stages.description: The project compiles or packages. Nothing later is meaningful if this fails.

stages.title: Lint
stages.description: Style and correctness rules the project has chosen to enforce.

stages.title: Typecheck
stages.description: Static types agree across the change.

stages.title: Unit tests
stages.description: Fast tests that do not need external services.

stages.title: Integration tests
stages.description: Tests that exercise real collaborators, and may need a database or network.

stages.title: Security
stages.description: Automated dependency and configuration checks. Not a substitute for security review.

stages.title: Independent review
stages.description: A reviewer who did not write the change assesses it. Cannot be disabled.

stages.title: Agent evaluation
stages.description: Assesses how the agent worked, which application tests cannot measure.

stages.title: Human approval
stages.description: A person accepts the change. Cannot be disabled.
